name: Get Up from Bed
description: Rise up from the bed and stand beside it.
successMessage: You stretch your limbs, swing your legs over the edge, and stand up steadily.

name: Stand Up
description: Stand up on your feet from your current seated or resting position.
successMessage: You stand up and regain your footing.

name: Lie Down on Bed
description: Lie down flat or sideways on the comfortable mattress.
successMessage: You recline gently onto the bed, sinking your head into the soft pillow.

name: Sit on Bed Edge
description: Sit comfortably on the edge of the bed.
successMessage: You sit down on the soft edge of the bed.

name: Sit at Study Desk
description: Sit on the ergonomic chair in front of the desk.
successMessage: You pull the desk chair out and sit comfortably at your workstation.

name: Sit on Kitchen Stool
description: Sit on the tall stool near the kitchen counter.
successMessage: You hop up onto the kitchen stool, resting your feet on the rung.

name: Turn Left
description: Rotate your body 90 degrees to the left.

name: Turn Right
description: Rotate your body 90 degrees to the right.
